body:
"That a suitable random number generator is used when randomness is required." -> "That a suitable random number generator is used"

In most setups at L1, you wouldn't have a dedicated "cryptographic module" per se.  Perhaps we can add in the Control Objective section that cryptographic modules refer to either physical devices responsible for cryptographic functions in the application or a software component in the application that calls cryptography-related APIs

Perhaps add a link to FIPS 140-2: https://csrc.nist.gov/publications/detail/fips/140/2/final

comments.body: Can you clarify "cryptographic modules refer to either physical devices responsible for cryptographic functions in the application or a software component in the application that calls cryptography-related APIs" in a new issue please?
